
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:protect=\meaning\protect}
\newcommand{\gmopt}[1][dflt]{\gdef\Observed{(#1)}}
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:public=\meaning\gmopt}
\expandafter\let\expandafter\hidden\csname\string\gmopt\endcsname
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:hidden=\meaning\hidden}
\gmopt
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:default=\Observed}
\gmopt [set]
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:supplied=\Observed}
\let\saved\gmopt
\begingroup
\renewcommand{\gmopt}[1][local]{\gdef\Observed{<#1>}}
\gmopt
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:local=\Observed}
\endgroup
\gmopt
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:restored=\Observed}
\saved[alias]
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:alias=\Observed}
\providecommand{\gmopt}[1][ignored]{bad}
\gmopt
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:provided-existing=\Observed}
\newcommand*{\plain}[2]{\gdef\Observed{#1/#2}}
\plain{a}{b}
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:starred=\Observed}
\@namedef{gm@named}{named}
\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:named=\gm@named}
\ifcsname neverdefined\endcsname\errmessage{Unexpected definition}\fi
\@ifundefined{neverdefined}{\immediate\write16{BOUNDARY:undefined=yes}}{\errmessage{Unexpected definition}}
\ifcsname neverdefined\endcsname\errmessage{Undefined lookup created a name}\fi
\end
